design.target: Both sleep midpoint and mean absolute change of breakfast/lunch/dinner clock times shift by at least the stated minutes at the next recorded occasion. This is observed timing change, not deterioration, persistent disruption or clinical diagnosis.
design.target_fields: Sleep start/end and three meal clock times are completely excluded from numerical DNB and matched deviation inputs. Only past/current numeric features issue scores; only a later record determines the proxy comparison.
design.timing: Use consecutive source-row pairs with individually unambiguous month/day and positive gaps within the documented Aug31-Sep20 period. Do not infer the year, repair ambiguous dates, fill intervening days, or interpret the observation gap as clinical warning lead time.
design.split: Five shuffled person folds fixed without inspecting outcomes. Test fold k; independent calibration fold k+1; remaining three folds supply first-record reference people. Every person receives held-out scores once. This is retrospective participant separation, not calendar-time deployment validation.
design.reference: First records of reference-only people, with complete input features; no claim these people are clinically stable. Mean and sample SD fitted on this reference only; no self inclusion or future records from test people.
design.score: Reuse existing personal_components: maximum proper single-linkage branch score, K-squared internal mean of absolute delta Pearson. Exploratory unscreened branches, not proven DNB modules or Chen's full clinical protocol.
design.threshold: Use independent calibration people's occasions 1-3; alert when score is strictly above their score quantile. Primary 0.9 defines a nominal top-decile screening budget, not a validated false-alarm rate or optimized operating point. Report 0.8 and 0.95 too.
design.proxy_cutoff: One hour is a transparent exploratory size-of-change convention, not a clinical diagnostic cutoff. Report 30/60/90 minutes without picking whichever favors DNB. Primary continuous comparison is rank association with min(sleep shift, mean meal shift), avoiding dependence on one binary cutoff.
design.controls: Same-feature mean absolute standardized deviation, same person partitions and calibration quantiles; additionally always-no-change accuracy on the identical eligible pairs.
design.uncertainty: 1000 participant-cluster resamples of fixed held-out predictions, including paired differences. Conditional on this split and fitted models; not full model-refitting uncertainty, not independent record resampling.
design.preservation: Source and earlier analyses unchanged. All 180 adjacent-row prediction attempts retained, including unusable dates or outcomes. No clinical labels written to the source database.
